terms.gloss: a solemn or public procession, at festivals, games, triumphs, weddings, and funerals
evidence: Cic. Tusc. 5.91: in pompā cum magna vīs aurī argentīque ferrētur (Lewis & Short)
Verg. G. 3.22: sollemnēs dūcere pompās ad dēlūbra juvat (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: in pompā cum magna vīs aurī argentīque ferrētur
phrases.english: when a great quantity of gold and silver was being carried in a procession

sources: Lewis & Short: pompa
